{"metadata":{"description":"模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harness: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel","id":"gh:1333705622","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-router","slug":"tianji-qingtian/dsh-model-router","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","model-router"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"模型路由与成本优化器：简单问题 flash 直答、故障自动降级、会话 token/缓存/成本实时面板 | Model router & cost optimizer for DeepSeek Harn"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ess: flash quick-answers for simple questions, failure fallback, live token/cache/cost panel"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Model Router & Cost Optimizer for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`). Answers simple questions directly on the"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" cheap model (zero prefix, no cache tax), degrades gracefully on transient provider failures, and sh"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"ows live per-session token / cache-hit / cost figures right under the composer."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> The harness is in developer preview and iterates quickly — expect compatibility-breaking changes."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 中文说明见 README.zh.md。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Cheap-model judge routing** — clearly heavy work (strong keywords / long payloads) goes straight"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" to the main model with zero added latency. Everything else is decided by a **zero-prefix flash judg"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"e call** (`SIMPLE` / `AGENTIC`, one word, 64-token cap, thinking off). The judge also sees the last "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"assistant reply, so context-dependent follow-ups (它 / 这个 / 继续 …) are never misrouted to a context-fr"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ee answer.
- **Ask before quick-answering** — in auto mode, every SIMPLE hit asks the user through t"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"he built-in question UI: **⚡ 快速回答（flash）** or **主模型回答**. Choosing the main model (or dismissing the "},{"id":"p7s7","text":"question) takes the normal flow; subagent sessions fall back automatically. The question text follow"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"s the request language.
- **Direct quick-answer** — when the user picks the quick option (or a quick"},{"id":"p7s9","text":" answer is otherwise produced), the router rejects the step, runs a **zero-prefix one-shot stream on"},{"id":"p7s10","text":" the cheap model** (no cache-miss tax), and writes the question + answer straight into the session l"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"og inside a step envelope — the user sees an ordinary Q&A; exchange prefixed with a `⚡ 快速回答 / Quick "},{"id":"p7s12","text":"answer · <model>` marker (matched to the question language), the main model never runs for it, and *"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"*no subagent sessions, relay cards, or toasts are created**. The main session's model and prefix cac"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"he are never touched.
- **Vision-aware routing** — messages carrying image blocks are routed to the "},{"id":"p7s15","text":"catalog's image-capable model when one exists (e.g. `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`), including the q"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"uick-answer judge/stream; without an image-capable model they fall back to the main model instead of"},{"id":"p7s17","text":" being answered blind on a text-only flash.
- **Model picker respected** — the router never override"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"s the model chosen in the composer picker or via `selectModel`, including relay/proxy providers (e.g"},{"id":"p7s19","text":". `kabuai`): `agent/request` passes the harness's requested config through unchanged, and quick answ"},{"id":"p7s20","text":"ers always run on the session provider's own cheap model. (No drift healing — its original cause, a "},{"id":"p7s21","text":"forged `request/header`, was removed at the root in v0.9.2.)
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The `dsh` CLI must be on your `PATH`. If you only ever ran the harness through `npx`, `dsh` is not i"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"nstalled and you will get `zsh: command not found: dsh` — install it globally first. This release ta"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"rgets harness `0.2.0-rc.1` (for an older harness use tag `v0.9.4`):"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` also works if your pnpm global bin dir is on `PATH` (otherwise pnpm a"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"sks you to run `pnpm setup` first). Alternatively skip the global install and prefix the commands be"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"low with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh …`."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Piece | Mechanism |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Step classification | `agent/pre-step` waterfall — strong-keyword fast path, then a zero-prefix fl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ash judge call (SIMPLE / AGENTIC) with the last assistant reply for reference detection |
| Quick an"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"swers | `agent/pre-step` rejects the step after a zero-prefix `llm.stream` on the cheap model; the q"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"uestion + answer are appended to the session log (`user/message` + a forged `step/start`…`assistant/"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"message`…`step/end` envelope) — the main model never runs |
| Model picker / relay | `agent/request`"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" passes the harness's requested config through unchanged — the composer picker, `selectModel`, and r"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"elay providers (e.g. `kabuai`) all work mid-session |
| Failure fallback | `agent/request-error` wat"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"erfall — returns `{ kind: 'retry' }` after flagging the turn; the retry re-enters `agent/request` an"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"d lands on the cheap model |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Harness compatibility"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Built and verified against harness `0.2.0-rc.1`. The `peerDependencies` ranges are
checked by the ha"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"rness at install and at profile startup — a plugin whose declared
range does not cover the running `"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"dsh --version` is refused (or skipped with
`skipping profile bundle …`), so an older plugin silently"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" disappears from the UI
after a harness upgrade."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"What 0.2.0 changed for this plugin (v0.9.4 → v0.9.5):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Change | Effect here |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| `assistant/message` must embed its exact model stream (`data.stream`) | The forged quick-answer se"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ttlement now carries `stream` (block start, text delta, closed block, usage, finish). Without it the"},{"id":"p19s3","text":" harness refuses the settlement at the seed/load boundary, so the session log would no longer open a"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"fter a restart |
| `tool-result` content blocks removed (tool results are their own `tool`-role mess"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"ages now) | The `agent/pre-step` fast path scores the current block vocabulary |
| `commands` regist"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ration races with a bare `ctx.get('commands')` | `commands` is now a hard injection, like the siblin"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"g `dsh-composer-polish` plugin |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Legacy `0.1.x` harnesses keep working through tag `v0.9.4`; this release intentionally
does not decl"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"are them, because the settlement shape differs."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Routing state is split: the auto/off mode is **durable** (folded by the projection from the sessio"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"n's `command/run` events, so it survives restarts), while the transient-failure degradation flag is "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"process-local and resets with the harness.
- `useProjection`-driven stats reflect the whole session "},{"id":"p22s4","text":"log — history recorded before installation is included, which is intentional.
- Direct quick answers"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" write a forged step envelope into the session log (usage is attributed from the message's own `sour"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ce.model`; no fake `request/header` is written since v0.9.2 — it would persist across restarts and m"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"is-attribute the first real call after resume). This satisfies the current session invariants (the s"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"tep is appended before the real step starts), but it is the most harness-coupled part of the plugin "},{"id":"p22s9","text":"— worth re-checking after harness upgrades."}],"truncated":true}
